title.value: Educating the future generation of researchers: A cross-disciplinary survey of trends in analysis methods
title.justification: The paper is focused on analyzing trends in analysis methods across various scientific disciplines, including a focus on education for future researchers.
title.quote: Educating the future generation of researchers: A cross-disciplinary survey of trends in analysis methods.

analysis.description: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of trends in analytic methods used in the biomedical, life, and social sciences over the past decade. It emphasizes the importance of adapting educational curricula to incorporate contemporary analytic methods, including machine learning and data science techniques.

type.justification: The paper performs a systematic survey of literature and analyzes mentions of analytic methods across numerous research articles, indicating an empirical approach.
type.quote: Our survey of peer-reviewed literature analyzed approximately 1.3 million openly available research articles to monitor the cross-disciplinary mentions of analytic methods in the past decade.

name.justification: The paper conducts a meta-research study by surveying and analyzing trends across numerous scientific research papers to understand the evolution of analytic methods.
name.quote: We argue that such reform should be based on data-driven insights into within- and cross-disciplinary use of analytic methods.

name.justification: The paper discusses the increasing prominence of machine learning methods such as neural networks in scientific research over the decade.
name.quote: Multivariate statistical and machine learning approaches, such as artificial neural networks (ANNs), have seen a significant increase in the total share of scientific publications.

name.justification: The paper uses natural language processing techniques to categorize and analyze large volumes of research articles.
name.quote: We applied natural language processing tools to a large corpus of open-access peer-reviewed literature.

name.justification: The paper discusses the need for integrating data science techniques into educational curricula to better prepare future researchers.
name.quote: Analysis of individual trends of each analytic method category reveals that while dominant, 'introductory' analytic methods have exhibited a decline, while 'advanced' analytic methods have shown a consistent increase in mentions.

name.justification: The paper mentions that artificial neural networks are among the machine learning methods seeing increased mentions in research.
name.quote: Multivariate statistical and machine learning approaches, such as artificial neural networks (ANNs), have seen a significant increase in the total share of scientific publications.

is_contributed.justification: The paper discusses ANN as a method that has gained popularity but does not imply any contribution to its development.
is_contributed.quote: The explosive adoption of neural networks across biology and multiple other fields illustrates the need for educational training to note these trends.

is_executed.justification: The paper analyzes mentions of ANNs in the literature and does not perform any execution or experimentation with them.
is_executed.quote: Our survey found that ... machine learning methods, such as artificial neural networks (ANNs), have seen a significant increase in the total share of scientific publications.

is_compared.justification: ANNs are mentioned as part of the comparative analysis of trends in analytic method mentions over time.
is_compared.quote: ...machine learning methods have exhibited a consistent, sometimes exponential, increase in mentions over the time span of the study.

referenced_paper_title.value: Improved protein structure prediction using potentials from deep learning
referenced_paper_title.justification: This reference to ANNs demonstrates their application and increased prominence in literature, linking the model to its broader application mentioned in the study.
referenced_paper_title.quote: deep learning, a machine learning technique developed by the artificial intelligence community, has successfully been used by biologists to predict three-dimensional protein structure.

name.value: PubMed Central Open Access Subset (PMC OAS)
name.justification: The paper analyzes a large number of research articles from this dataset, making it integral to their study.
name.quote: Two sources of peer-reviewed literature were used for this analysis: the Pubmed Central Open Access Subset (PMC OAS) (N = 2,869,889 articles at time of study); and the Pubmed Central Author Manuscript (PMC AM).

referenced_paper_title.value: PMC text mining subset in BioC: about three million full-text articles and growing
referenced_paper_title.justification: The dataset is used for text mining and analysis of trends in analytic methods across disciplines.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Both sources form part of PMC’s open access collection (37) (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/tools/textmining/). Bulk downloads of the full OAS and AM collection articles were conducted using the PMC FTP service.

name.justification: spaCy is explicitly mentioned as the library used for natural language processing tasks within the study.
name.quote: To perform NER on our full corpus, we used the convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm provided by the open-source spaCy python package.

referenced_paper_title.value: The spacy natural language processing library
referenced_paper_title.justification: spaCy is acknowledged as a critical tool used for processing and analyzing the data in this study.
referenced_paper_title.quote: To perform NER on our full corpus, we used the convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm provided by the open-source spaCy python package.
